title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，
正确的动作是减仓，不是加仓。

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin alert and liquidation
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn’t happen in an instant—it’s a process. Understand how it works, and you’ll know when to act.

[Step 1] Initial margin: The funds tied up when you open a position. For example, with 10x leverage, it’s 10% of the position size.
[Step 2] The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts showing “Insufficient margin” alerts,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position to lower leverage, or add margin.
[Step 3] Maintenance margin level: Losses eat into your maintenance margin, and the system begins partially liquidating your position,
closing part of the position first to reduce risk, rather than closing it all at once.

This conclusion depends on whether Titan Builder’s revenue really came mainly from the transaction flow during that period, rather than merely reflecting accounting figures.

First, the facts. According to data from DefiLlama cited by PANews, Titan Builder earned $22.83 million in the past 24 hours, ranking first in protocol revenue. The same report said that, to convert freezeable stablecoins into assets such as ETH, the hacker made large purchases within an hour and paid about $119 million extra. At one point, the largest ETH/USDT pool on Ethereum was priced 38% above the market rate, drawing a rush of arbitrage bots. Bitquery estimated that tips paid to block builders that evening totaled 10,251 ETH, compared with 4.6 ETH at the same time the previous evening. These figures all come from a single media report, and the methodologies behind them vary by source, so their attribution should be retained.

In terms of how it works, builders determine the order of transactions within a block. The more concentrated and short-lived the arbitrage opportunity, the more bots are willing to tip for getting “on-chain first.” The more participants pay, the more valuable ordering rights become. My inference is that Titan’s surge in revenue looks more like a toll collected amid the chaos than a result of taking directional risk itself. The report says Titan does not trade on its own account; if true, that would make the revenue more akin to a fee for transaction flow.

But there are conditions under which this conclusion would not hold. If MEV tips in subsequent blocks fall rapidly, that would suggest this was a one-off event premium. If the hacker stops rotating assets or the funds are frozen, the source of transaction flow would also disappear. Evidence still missing includes the share of Titan’s revenue attributable to that period, the precise methodology for allocating tips, and whether independent data beyond Bitquery can corroborate the figures. The report’s claim that “two of the four crash-like revenue peaks came from other people’s disasters” is media narration, not an established pattern.

translatedData.title: What’s the difference between isolated and cross margin? Which should beginners use?
translatedData.subTitle:
When opening a futures position, you’ll be asked to choose between “isolated margin” and “cross margin.” Many beginners just tap one at random and end up taking a big loss.

【Cross margin】All the balance in your account is used as margin. Advantage: the liquidation price is farther away, so you’re less likely to get liquidated;
Disadvantage: in an extreme market, losses could wipe out your entire account. It’s like putting all your eggs in one
They support each other in the basket.

【Isolated margin】Only a specific amount of money is allocated to this position. If it gets liquidated, you can lose at most that amount,
and the loss won’t spread to your other positions or your principal. The risk is kept in a cage.

【My advice】Beginners should always use isolated margin. The reason is simple: you’re not yet able to assess the worst-case scenario for a single bad trade
